words.definition: used to ask and talk about particular amounts of time; tall, full-bottomed; rare, aspire; chronically, ever more
words.translation: 渴望；长的；过长的；做多头的；热望；长期地；始终

examples.en: How long will it take to get there?
examples.zh: 到那里去要多长时间？

examples.en: Try to keep going foras long as possible.
examples.zh: 能坚持多久就坚持多久。

examples.en: Ittookme longerthan I thought it would.
examples.zh: 我用的时间比原先想的要长。

words.definition: to use less money, time, energy etc so that you do not waste any; hold, economize on; economize on, spare no effort; succor
words.translation: 节省；保存；储蓄；解救；挽救；救球；救球，救援

examples.en: We’ll save a lot of time if we go by car.
examples.zh: 我们要是开车去，可以节省很多时间。

examples.en: Everyone is being encouraged to save energy.
examples.zh: 每个人都被鼓励节约能源。

examples.en: ways to save money on heating bills
examples.zh: 节省取暖费的种种办法

words.definition: how good or bad something is; talent, capability, ability, identity, character
words.translation: 品质；质量，[统计]品质；特性；才能

examples.en: Much of the land was of poor quality.
examples.zh: 很多地的土质很差。

examples.en: Use only high quality ingredients.
examples.zh: 只使用上等的材料。

words.definition: something that is available is able to be used or can easily be bought or found; valid, effective, virtual, telling, significant
words.translation: 可利用的，现有的；可获得的；[交]有效的，可得的；可利用的；空闲的

examples.en: Tickets are available from the box office.
examples.zh: 售票处有票出售。

examples.en: Meetings were held to update employees as soon as new information became available .
examples.zh: 一有新的信息就开会告诉员工。

examples.en: Further building can continue when money is made available .
examples.zh: 有了资金就可以继续进一步的施工。

words.definition: a way of doing or achieving something; ways, methods, techniques, modes, assets; purposes
words.translation: 方法；手段；财产（mean的复数）；意思是；打算（mean的第三人称单数）

examples.en: The only means of communication was sign language.
examples.zh: 唯一的交流方法是手语。

examples.en: The window was our only means of escape .
examples.zh: 跳窗是我们唯一的逃生方法。

examples.en: Do you have any means of identification ?
examples.zh: 你有什么身份证明文件吗？

words.definition: relating to education, especially at college or university level; theoretical, collegial; undergraduate, don, scholar, college student, university student
words.translation: 学校(院)的，学术的；学术的；理论的；学院的；大学生，大学教师；学者

examples.en: He possessed no academic qualifications.
examples.zh: 他没有学历。

examples.en: a program to raise academic standards
examples.zh: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

words.definition: expected to happen or arrive at a particular time; expected, mature, just, payable, prospective; plumb
words.translation: 到期的；预期的；应付的；应得的；正（置于方位词前）

examples.en: The next income tax payment is due on 31 January.
examples.zh: 下一次的所得税支付期限是1月31日。

words.definition: very large or important, when compared to other things or people of a similar kind; crucial, important, primary, considerable, central; adult
words.translation: 主要的；主修；重要的；主修的；较多的；[人类]成年人；主修科目；陆军少校

examples.en: There are two major political parties in the US.
examples.zh: 美国有两大政党。

examples.en: The government’s major concern is with preventing road accidents.
examples.zh: 政府关注的大事是预防道路交通事故。

examples.en: Smoking is one of the major causes of cancer.
examples.zh: 吸烟是引发癌症的元凶之一。

words.definition: to think that someone or something is important; importance, significance, price, stress, weight; score, rate, prize
words.translation: 重视；[数]值；[经]价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义；评价；估价

examples.en: Shelley valued her privacy.
examples.zh: 谢利很重视自己的隐私。

words.definition: to find information, especially on a computer; the right to enter a place, use something, see someone etc; make use of, fashion, employ, border, exercise; opening, admittance
words.translation: 获取；接近，入口；使用；[计]存取；接近；进入；使用权；[电]通路

examples.en: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
examples.zh: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

words.definition: the place where someone or something is, especially in relation to other objects and places
words.translation: 职位

examples.en: Our hotel was in a superb central position near St Mark’s Square.
examples.zh: 我们的酒店处于极佳的中心位置，在圣马克广场附近。

examples.en: the strategic position (= useful or important position ) of Egypt in relation to the Arabian peninsula
examples.zh: 埃及相对于阿拉伯半岛的战略位置

words.definition: the average amount is the amount you get when you add together several quantities and divide this by the total number of quantities; evenness, typical value; mean, ordinary, general
words.translation: 平常的；平均；[数]平均数；[保险]海损；[数]平均的；普通的

examples.en: The age of the candidates ranged from 29 to 49 with an average age of 37.
examples.zh: 候选人的年龄29岁至49岁不等，平均37岁。

examples.en: The average cost of making a movie has risen by 15%.
examples.zh: 制作一部影片的平均成本上升了15%。

examples.en: Last winter was colder than average.
examples.zh: 去年冬天比平常冷。

words.definition: facts or signs that show clearly that something exists or is true; authentication, certification, demonstration, proof, breath; demonstrate, prove, argue, bear witness to
words.translation: 根据，证据，迹象；[法]证据，证明；迹象；明显；证明

examples.en: Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
examples.zh: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

words.definition: relating to money or the management of money; monetary, fiscal
words.translation: 财政的，经济的；金融的；财政的，财务的

examples.en: financial transactions
examples.zh: 财务往来

examples.en: financial assistance
examples.zh: 财务援助

examples.en: a financial advisor
examples.zh: 财务顾问

words.definition: the introduction of new ideas or methods; reformation, renovation, renewal
words.translation: 改革，创新；创新，革新；新方法

examples.en: We must encourage innovation if the company is to remain competitive.
examples.zh: 公司要想保持竞争力，就必须鼓励革新。

examples.en: Many people feel bewildered by the speed of technological innovation.
examples.zh: 很多人对技术革新的速度感到不知所措。

words.definition: an advantage or good feature of something; to be good, important, or serious enough for praise or attention; asset, importance, virtue, price, value; to be worth, be deserving of
words.translation: 优点，成绩；值得；优点，价值；功绩；功过

examples.en: The merit of the report is its realistic assessment of the changes required.
examples.zh: 这份报告的优点就是它对所要求的变动进行了实事求是的评估。

examples.en: The great merit of the project is its flexibility and low cost.
examples.zh: 该项目最大的优点是它的灵活性和低成本。

examples.en: Each of these approaches to teaching has its merits .
examples.zh: 这些教学方法每一种都有其优点。

words.definition: the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect; likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future; possibility, probability, feasibility, maybe, chance; feasible, possible, underlying, latent
words.translation: 潜力；有可能的；潜在的；潜能；可能性；[电]电势；可能的；势的

examples.en: The boy has great potential.
examples.zh: 这个男孩有很大的潜力。

words.definition: almost the same; alike, like; analog
words.translation: 相似的；类似物

examples.en: We have similar tastes in music.
examples.zh: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

examples.en: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
examples.zh: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

examples.en: A number of his friends had been affected in a similar way .
examples.zh: 他的一些朋友也受到了类似的影响。

words.definition: if you benefit from something, or it benefits you, it gives you an advantage, improves your life, or helps you in some way; behalf, sake, profit, advantage, plus; profit, be good for
words.translation: 有益于，有助于；利益，好处；救济金；有益于，对…有益

examples.en: They are working together to benefit the whole community.
examples.zh: 他们在为整个社区的利益共同努力。

words.definition: communication with a person, organization, country etc; touch, link; meet, to link
words.translation: 联系，接触；[电][电子]接触，联系；联系，[电][电子]接触

examples.en: The town is cut off from contact with the outside world.
examples.zh: 小镇与外界的联系被切断了。

words.definition: the desire to know about something; treasure, pearl
words.translation: 好奇心；好奇，好奇心；珍品，古董，古玩

examples.en: I opened the packet just to satisfy my curiosity .
examples.zh: 我打开包裹只是为了满足我的好奇心。

examples.en: The news aroused a lot of curiosity among local people.
examples.zh: 这条消息在当地人中间引起了很大的好奇心。

examples.en: She decided to follow him out of curiosity .
examples.zh: 她出于好奇决定跟踪他。

words.definition: happening or existing now; recent, now, universal, late, present; tendency, direction, tide, trend, set
words.translation: 当前的；现在的；流通的，通用的；最近的；草写的；（水，气，电）[流]流；趋势；涌流

examples.en: the current President
examples.zh: 现任总统

examples.en: In its current state, the car is worth £1,000.
examples.zh: 这辆车按现在的车况来看值1,000英镑。

words.definition: to have enough money to buy or pay for something; allow, deal, extend, deliver, tender
words.translation: 负担得起；给予，提供；买得起

examples.en: I couldn’t afford the rent on my own.
examples.zh: 我单靠自己付不起房租。

examples.en: How can she afford to eat out every night?
examples.zh: 每天晚上下馆子她怎么能负担得起？

words.definition: if one thing includes another, the second thing is part of the first; involve, contain, comprise
words.translation: 包含；包含，包括

examples.en: Does the price include postage?
examples.zh: 这个价格包含邮费吗？

examples.en: His job includes looking after under-21 teams.
examples.zh: 他的职责包括照管21岁以下球队。

examples.en: The curriculum includes courses in computing.
examples.zh: 课程内容包括计算机技术。

words.definition: when someone performs a play or a piece of music; property, capability, enforcement, execution, implementing
words.translation: 演出，履行，表现；性能；绩效；表演；执行

examples.en: This evening’s performance will begin at 8.00 pm.
examples.zh: 今晚的演出8点开始。

words.definition: to need something; lack, exact, desire, order, command
words.translation: 要求，命令；需要；要求；命令

examples.en: Campbell’s broken leg will probably require surgery.
examples.zh: 坎贝尔的一条腿骨折，可能需要手术。

examples.en: What’s required is a complete reorganization of the system.
examples.zh: 需要做的是彻底整顿整个系统。

examples.en: Most house plants require regular watering.
examples.zh: 大多数室内盆栽植物需要定期浇水。

words.definition: showing that someone has been well trained and is good at their work; vocational, specialized, occupational; career man
words.translation: 专业的；职业的；职业性的；[管理]专业人员；职业运动员

examples.en: This business plan looks very professional.
examples.zh: 这个商业计划看上去很有专业水平。

examples.en: a more professional approach to work
examples.zh: 更专业的工作方法

words.definition: related to someone’s body rather than their mind or emotions; personal, material, natural; medical examination, check-up
words.translation: 身体上的；[物]物理的；身体的；物质的；体格检查

examples.en: She was in constant physical pain.
examples.zh: 她一直感到身上疼痛。

examples.en: the physical and emotional needs of young adults
examples.zh: 青年人的身心需求

examples.en: people with severe physical disabilities
examples.zh: 身体重度残疾的人

words.definition: to ask a large number of people questions in order to find out their attitudes or opinions; a set of questions that you ask a large number of people in order to find out about their opinions or behaviour; investigation, measurement, probe, research; examine, check into
words.translation: 调查，审视，仔细考虑；勘测，测量，测绘，调查；调查；测量；审视；纵览；[测][油气]勘测；俯瞰

examples.en: Of the 100 companies surveyed, 10% had a turnover of £50 m to £99 m.
examples.zh: 被调查的 100 家公司中，10% 的公司营业额在 5,000 万到 9,900 万英镑之间。

words.definition: belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago; old, aged, advanced; elder, old folk
words.translation: 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的；古代人；老人

examples.en: the ancient civilizations of Asia
examples.zh: 亚洲的古代文明

words.definition: to make certain that something will happen properly; undertake, assure, insure
words.translation: 确保；保证，确保；使安全

examples.en: facilities to ensure the safety of cyclists
examples.zh: 确保骑车人安全的设施

words.definition: extremely good or of very high quality; remarkable, wonderful, famous, prominent, brilliant
words.translation: 卓越的，杰出的，极好的；卓越的；极好的；杰出的

examples.en: an excellent suggestion
examples.zh: 极好的建议

examples.en: His car is in excellent condition.
examples.zh: 他的汽车状况极佳。

examples.en: Second-hand computers can be excellent value.
examples.zh: 二手计算机买得好会非常合算。

words.definition: the effect or influence that an event, situation etc has on someone or something; affect, influence, reach, work on, strike; charge at; effect, impression, influence, infection, affection
words.translation: 影响；[力]撞击；冲突；压紧；[力]冲击；产生影响；效果；[物]碰撞；[力]冲击力

examples.en: They say they expect the meeting to have a marked impact on the future of the country.
examples.zh: 他们说期望这次会议对国家的未来产生显著的影响。

words.definition: a series of actions that are done in order to achieve a particular result; to deal with an official document, request etc in the usual way; manufacture, cope with; going on, course, system, method, approach
words.translation: 过程，进程；工序；(法律)程序；处理；加工；过程，进行；方法，步骤；作用；程序；推移

examples.en: the Israeli-Egyptian peace process
examples.zh: 以－埃和平进程

examples.en: Repetition can help the learning process.
examples.zh: 重复对学习过程会有帮助。

words.definition: to make something smaller or less in size, amount, or price; shorten, weaken; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 减少；降低；使处于；把…分解；缩小；归纳为

examples.en: The governor announced a new plan to reduce crime.
examples.zh: 州长宣布了一项降低犯罪率的新计划。

examples.en: The helmet law should reduce injuries in motorcycle accidents.
examples.zh: 头盔法的实施应该能减少摩托车事故的受伤率。

examples.en: Small businesses will need to reduce costs in order to survive.
examples.zh: 小企业要想生存必须削减成本。

words.definition: to prevent something bad from happening; eliminate, escape, shun
words.translation: 避免；避开，躲避；消除

examples.en: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
examples.zh: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

examples.en: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
examples.zh: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

examples.en: Alan narrowly avoided an accident.
examples.zh: 艾伦险出事故。

words.definition: a unit for measuring temperature. It can be shown as a symbol after a number. For example, 70° means 70 degrees.; extent, classification, measure, grade, plane
words.translation: 程度；程度，等级；度；学位；阶层

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees.
examples.zh: 把烘箱预热至425度。

words.definition: a change that is caused by an event, action etc; impression, influence, infection, affection, impact; form, inspire
words.translation: 影响；效果；作用；产生；达到目的

examples.en: the long-term effects of the drug
examples.zh: 这种毒品的长期影响

examples.en: I could feel the effects of the thin mountain air.
examples.zh: 我能感觉到山上稀薄空气产生的影响。

examples.en: This ingredient also has the effect of making your skin look younger.
examples.zh: 这种成分还有使皮肤看上去更年轻的效果。

words.definition: a carefully planned piece of work to get information about something, to build something, to improve something etc; design, engineer; design, schedule, engineer, style, frame; engineering, career, enterprise, plan, scheme
words.translation: 工程，作业；设计；计划；表达；投射；发射；放映；工程；事业

examples.en: The project aims to provide an analysis of children’s emotions.
examples.zh: 该计划旨在对儿童情绪作出分析。

examples.en: a three-year research project
examples.zh: 一项为期三年的研究计划

examples.en: The scheme will now be extended after a successful pilot project (= a small trial to test if an idea will be successful ) .
examples.zh: 试行成功后，该方案现在将得到推广。

words.definition: happening every hour, every week, every month etc, usually with the same amount of time in between; qualified, stated, ordered, straight, periodic; familiar, elite; frequently, periodically
words.translation: 有规律的，经常的；定期的；有规律的；合格的；[植]整齐的；常客；正式队员；中坚分子；定期地；经常地

examples.en: The company holds regular meetings with employees.
examples.zh: 公司定期召集雇员开会。

examples.en: His breathing was slow and regular.
examples.zh: 他的呼吸缓慢而均匀。

examples.en: Trains will run at regular intervals from 11 am to 4 pm.
examples.zh: 火车从上午11点到下午4点每隔一定时间开行。

words.definition: a lot of things of the same type that are different from each other in some way; category, manner, nature, kind, sort
words.translation: 多样；种类；杂耍

examples.en: The girls come from a variety of different backgrounds.
examples.zh: 这些女孩出身背景各不相同。

words.definition: to say that you are annoyed, not satisfied, or unhappy about something or someone; whine about, beef; beef about, rail against
words.translation: 抱怨；投诉；发牢骚；诉说；控诉

examples.en: Residents are complaining because traffic in the area has increased.
examples.zh: 由于这个地区的交通流量有所增加，居民都在抱怨。

examples.en: ‘You never ask my opinion about anything,’ Rod complained.
examples.zh: “你什么事都不问问我的看法。”罗德抱怨道。

examples.en: Employees complained bitterly about working conditions.
examples.zh: 雇员们对工作条件十分不满。

words.definition: two people who are married or having a sexual or romantic relationship; immune to, conjugality; bond, become one, combine; become one, join together
words.translation: 夫妻，情侣；对；夫妇；数个；结合；成婚；连接；连合

examples.en: a newly married couple
examples.zh: 一对新婚夫妇

examples.en: the couple next door
examples.zh: 隔壁的那对夫妇

words.definition: to decrease in quantity or importance; reduction, recession, fall; go down, slump; excuse oneself from
words.translation: 下降，减少；拒绝；下降；衰退；斜面；衰落；谢绝；婉拒

examples.en: Spending on information technology has declined.
examples.zh: 用于信息技术的支出减少了。

examples.en: Car sales have declined by a quarter.
examples.zh: 汽车销量下滑了四分之一。

examples.en: After the war, the city declined in importance.
examples.zh: 战后这座城市的重要性下降了。

words.definition: books, plays, poems etc that people think are important and good; writing, letter
words.translation: 文学，文学作品；文献；[语]文学；[图情]文献；文艺；著作

examples.en: He has read many of the major works of literature.
examples.zh: 他读过许多重要的文学作品。

examples.en: Italian literature
examples.zh: 意大利文学

words.definition: to be important, especially to be important to you, or to have an effect on what happens; substance, event, consideration, circumstance, occurrence, scene; to be related, make a difference
words.translation: 要紧，重要；[物]物质；原因；事件；有关系；要紧

examples.en: If I have to stay late at work tonight, it won’t matter because we can go out another night.
examples.zh: 如果今晚我必须工作到很晚的话，那也没关系，我们可以改天晚上再出去。

examples.en: Does it matter what I think?
examples.zh: 我怎么想重要吗？

examples.en: Do you think it matters that the cups and saucers don’t match?
examples.zh: 你觉得茶杯与杯托不相配要紧吗？

words.definition: to think that something is probably true, based on what you know; expect, have, count, say, guess; believe, imagine
words.translation: 料想，以为；假定；期望；假设；认为；让（虚拟语气）；推想；猜想；料想

examples.en: There were many more deaths than was first supposed.
examples.zh: 死亡人数远远超过最初的预料。

examples.en: (= it is unlikely that ) he’s lying.
examples.zh: 没有理由认为他在说谎。

words.definition: a thing, place, activity etc that you get something from; provenience, authorship
words.translation: 来源；水源；原始资料

examples.en: They get their money from various sources.
examples.zh: 他们从各种途径弄到钱。

words.definition: to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard; accomplish, carry out, perform, complete, fulfil; gain one's ends, Make it.
words.translation: 完成，实现；达到；完成；达到目的；如愿以偿

examples.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
examples.zh: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

examples.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
examples.zh: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

examples.en: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
examples.zh: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

words.definition: an opinion you give someone about what they should do; suggestion, proposal, information, instance, notice
words.translation: 建议；忠告；劝告；通知

examples.en: You should have followed my advice.
examples.zh: 你真该听我的建议。

words.definition: drinks such as beer or wine that contain a substance which can make you drunk; ethanol, ethylalcohol
words.translation: 酒精；[有化]酒精，乙醇

examples.en: I don’t drink alcohol anymore.
examples.zh: 我不再喝酒了。

examples.en: {"GLOSS":["when someone drinks too much"],"COLLOINEXA":["alcohol abuse"]}
examples.zh: 酗酒

examples.en: people with alcohol problems
examples.zh: 有酗酒问题的人

words.definition: remarks that say what you think is bad about someone or something; comment, animadversion
words.translation: 批评；考证；苛求

examples.en: Despite strong criticism , the new system is still in place.
examples.zh: 尽管遭到了猛烈的批评，新制度依然原封不动。

examples.en: There has been widespread criticism of the decision.
examples.zh: 这一决定受到了普遍的批评。

examples.en: We try to give students constructive criticism .
examples.zh: 我们设法对学生提出有建设性的批评。

words.definition: as different as possible from something else; contrary, adverse, counter, against, cross; antithesis, antonym; across
words.translation: 相反的；[植]对面的；对立的；对立面；反义词；在对面

examples.en: I thought the medicine would make him sleep, but it had the opposite effect.
examples.zh: 我以为这药会让他睡觉，但是它却起了反作用。

examples.en: At the opposite extreme, Ashworth’s style is very simple and modern.
examples.zh: 截然相反的是，阿什沃思的风格非常简单和现代。

examples.en: Bob was quicker than Ed? It’s usually the opposite way round.
examples.zh: 鲍勃比埃德快？通常是反过来的。

words.definition: the limits within which amounts, quantities, ages etc vary; if prices, levels, temperatures etc range from one amount to another, they include both those amounts and anything in between; extent, boundary, region, scope, spectrum, territory, area; reach, parallel with; feed, grass
words.translation: 范围；在范围内变化；幅度；排；[地理]山脉；平行，列为一行；延伸；漫游；射程达到；放牧；使并列；归类于；来回走动

examples.en: a temperature range of 72-85˚
examples.zh: 72 度到85度之间的温度范围

examples.en: Even the cheapest property was out of our price range (= too expensive for us ) .
examples.zh: 即使是最便宜的房子也超出了我们能承受的价格范围。

words.definition: if someone is responsible for an accident, mistake, crime etc, it is their fault or they can be blamed; honest, reliable, tried, safe, sure
words.translation: 负责的，有责任的；[法]负责的，可靠的；有责任的

examples.en: We are determined to bring the people responsible to justice.
examples.zh: 我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。

words.definition: continuous feelings of worry about your work or personal life, that prevent you from relaxing; pressure, significance, intensity, heat, tension; emphasize, tension, highlight
words.translation: 压力,重音；压力；强调；紧张；重要性；重读；使紧张；加压力于；用重音读

examples.en: Your headaches are due to stress.
examples.zh: 你的头痛是压力造成的。

examples.en: Janet’s been under a lot of stress since her mother’s illness.
examples.zh: 珍妮特自从母亲生病以来承受了很大的压力。

examples.en: all the stresses of public life
examples.zh: 公众生活的所有压力

words.definition: extremely important and necessary; elementary, fundamental, basic, necessary, primary; element, principle, entity, necessity, requirement, texture
words.translation: 本质的，必须的；基本的；必要的；本质的；精华的；本质；要素；要点；必需品

examples.en: Window locks are fairly cheap and absolutely essential.
examples.zh: 窗锁相当便宜，绝对有必要安装。

examples.en: Even in small companies, computers are an essential tool.
examples.zh: 即使在小公司里，计算机也是不可或缺的工具。

words.definition: for use by one person or group, not for everyone; chamber, cabinet; seaman second class
words.translation: 私人的；私有的；私下的；列兵；二等兵

examples.en: Morris has a private jet.
examples.zh: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

examples.en: He made some notes for his private use.
examples.zh: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

examples.en: They objected to any form of private property .
examples.zh: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

words.definition: used to show that you are talking about someone or something that has not been mentioned before, or that your listener does not know about
words.translation: 一(个)；每一(个)

examples.en: We have a problem.
examples.zh: 我们遇到了一个麻烦。

examples.en: There was a hole in the fence.
examples.zh: 篱笆上有一个洞。

examples.en: Suddenly they heard a loud bang.
examples.zh: 他们突然听到砰的一声巨响。

words.definition: the state of being able to do something; capacity, competence, talent, quality, power
words.translation: 能力；能耐，本领；能力，能耐；才能

examples.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
examples.zh: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

words.definition: clever or good at doing something; capable, efficient, competent
words.translation: 有能力的；出色的；能；[经管]有能力的；能干的

examples.en: one of my more able students
examples.zh: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

words.definition: concerning or relating to a particular subject; concerning, as for, with reference to, round, in relation to; close-at-hand; around, approximately, everywhere, throughout, something
words.translation: 关于；在…周围；大约；在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的；周围；到处

examples.en: a book about politics
examples.zh: 一本有关政治的书

examples.en: She said something about leaving town.
examples.zh: 她说了些要离开镇子的话。

examples.en: He lied about his age.
examples.zh: 他谎报年龄。

words.definition: through; opposite
words.translation: 横过；在…对面；穿过；横穿；在对面

words.definition: things that people do, especially in order to achieve a particular aim; movement, doing, campaign, working, act
words.translation: 活动；活力；行动；活跃

examples.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
examples.zh: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

examples.en: fund-raising activities
examples.zh: 筹款活动

examples.en: Regular physical activity helps to control your weight.
examples.zh: 定期参加体育活动有助于控制体重。

words.definition: used to add new information to what you have just said, to give your opinion, or to start a new conversation; really, effectively, virtually, even, practically
words.translation: 实际上；竟然；事实上

examples.en: I’ve known Barbara for years. Since we were babies, actually.
examples.zh: 我认识芭芭拉很多年了，实际上我们从小就认识。

examples.en: Actually, on second thoughts, I don’t think I want to go out tonight.
examples.zh: 其实再想想，我今晚不打算出去了。

words.definition: a good or useful feature that something has; behalf, superiority, asset, benefit, edge; gain, make a profit; favor of, be conducive to
words.translation: 优点，优势；好处；优势；[经]利益；有利条件；获利；有利于；使处于优势

examples.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=  have an advantage  ) when applying for jobs.
examples.zh: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

words.definition: when a particular event or time has happened, or when someone has done something; since, subsequently; in the back of; succeeding
words.translation: 在…以后；次于；后来，以后；在……之后；以后的

examples.en: After the war many soldiers stayed in France.
examples.zh: 战后，许多士兵留在法国。

examples.en: I go swimming every day after work.
examples.zh: 我每天下班后都去游泳。

examples.en: Do you believe in life after death?
examples.zh: 你相信人死后还有来生吗？

words.definition: one more time – used when something has happened or been done before; moreover, besides, additionally, then, both
words.translation: 又一次；而且；又，此外；再一次

examples.en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
examples.zh: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

examples.en: I’ll never go there again.
examples.zh: 我再也不会去那儿了。

examples.en: Mr Khan’s busy. Can you try again later?
examples.zh: 卡恩先生正忙着。 你能不能过一会儿再打来？

words.definition: next to and touching an upright surface, especially for support; in opposition to, in contravention of; adverse, contrary, opposite, disadvantageous
words.translation: 倚在；逆，对着；反对，违反；靠；倚；防备；不利的；对立的

examples.en: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
examples.zh: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

examples.en: The younger policeman was leaning against the bureau with his arms folded.
examples.zh: 那位较年轻的警官两臂交叉，倚靠在办公桌旁。

words.definition: the number of years someone has lived or something has existed; to start looking older or to make someone or something look older; era, time, stage, phase, grade; mature, flower; grey, ripen
words.translation: 年龄；时代；变老；寿命，使用年限；阶段；成熟；使成熟；使变老，使上年纪

examples.en: Francis is the same age as me.
examples.zh: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

examples.en: Experts disagree over the age of the drawings.
examples.zh: 专家对这些画作的年代意见不统一。

examples.en: Dad retired at the age of 56.
examples.zh: 爸爸是在56岁时退休的。

words.definition: to have or express the same opinion about something as someone else; undertake, accept, recognize, side, grant; accept, grant
words.translation: 同意；持相同意见；赞成；承认；意见一致

examples.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
examples.zh: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

words.definition: help that you need to do a particular thing; assistance, friend, hand, help, boost; facilitate, bolster up; lend a hand, to help
words.translation: 帮助，救护；助手；援助；帮助；帮助者；有助于

examples.en: Foreign aid from many countries poured into the famine area.
examples.zh: 来自许多国家的救援物资纷纷送到饥荒地区。

words.definition: entire, overall, total; utterly, sheerly; full, entirety, allness
words.translation: 全部的；全部；全然地；越发

words.definition: to let someone do or have something, or let something happen; afford, let, have, deal, extend; think of, think about
words.translation: 允许，准许；任；允许；给予；认可；容许；考虑

examples.en: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
examples.zh: 泳池内禁止跳水。

words.definition: nearly, but not completely or not quite; nearly, most, virtually, practically, feckly
words.translation: 几乎，差不多；差不多，几乎

examples.en: Have you almost finished?
examples.zh: 你差不多完成了吗？

examples.en: Supper’s almost ready.
examples.zh: 晚饭就要做好了。

examples.en: It was almost midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜将至。

words.definition: if you are alone in a place, there is no one with you; Alone is also an adverb; independent, isolated, separate, sole; respectively, solely
words.translation: 单独的；单独地；独自的；孤独的；独自地

examples.en: She lives alone .
examples.zh: 她一个人生活。

examples.en: You shouldn’t leave a child alone in the house.
examples.zh: 你不应该把小孩独自留在家里。

examples.en: My wife and I like to spend time alone together away from the kids.
examples.zh: 我和妻子喜欢没有孩子打扰，过二人世界。

words.definition: from one place on something such as a line, road, or edge towards the other end of it; going forward; forth, together, to, ahead, front; down
words.translation: 沿着；向前；一起；来到；顺着

examples.en: We were driving along Follyfoot Road.
examples.zh: 我们沿着福莱福特路行驶。

examples.en: She glanced anxiously along the line of faces.
examples.zh: 她焦急地扫视着这一排面孔。

examples.en: He slid his hand along her arm.
examples.zh: 他的手顺着她的臂膀滑下。

words.definition: before now, or before a particular time; yet
words.translation: 早已，已经；已经，早已；先前

examples.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
examples.zh: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

examples.en: The performance had already started when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

words.definition: in addition to something else that you have mentioned; moreover, too, besides, either, likewise
words.translation: 亦，也；而且，还；也；而且；同样

examples.en: Information is also available on women’s health care.
examples.zh: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

examples.en: She sings beautifully and also plays the flute and piano.
examples.zh: 她歌唱得好，而且还会吹长笛和弹钢琴。

examples.en: The system was not only complicated but also ineffective.
examples.zh: 这套系统不仅复杂而且效率低。

words.definition: used to introduce a statement that makes your main statement seem surprising or unlikely; while, though, as, albeit
words.translation: 尽管，虽然；虽然，尽管

examples.en: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
examples.zh: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

examples.en: We decided to take rooms in Longwood House, although we knew we could not really afford the rent.
examples.zh: 虽然我们知道自己其实付不起租金，但还是决定住朗伍德庄园的房间。

examples.en: Although I can’t help admiring the man’s courage, I do not approve of his methods.
examples.zh: 尽管我不得不佩服那个男子的勇气，却并不赞成他的方法。

words.definition: all the time, at all times, or every time; forever and ever, immer
words.translation: 总是，一直；永远；永远，一直；总是；常常

examples.en: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
examples.zh: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

examples.en: She’d always assumed that Gabriel was a girl’s name.
examples.zh: 她一直认为加布里埃尔是个女孩名字。

examples.en: He hadn’t always been a butler.
examples.zh: 他并不是一直当管家。

words.definition: United States, U.S.A
words.translation: 美洲；美国；美洲（包括北美和南美洲）

examples.en: I may go to America or I may not,it all depends.
examples.zh: 我也许去美国，也许不去，要视情况而定。

examples.en: She scampered in London then went back to America.
examples.zh: 她在伦敦匆忙地游览了一番，然后回到了美国。

examples.en: Some of the mountains in America have not yet been mapped out.
examples.zh: 美洲有些山脉还没有在地图上标出来。

words.definition: relating to the US or its people; someone from the US
words.translation: 美洲的；美国人

examples.en: Her mother is American.
examples.zh: 她妈妈是美国人。

examples.en: a famous American writer
examples.zh: 一位著名的美国作家

words.definition: in or through the middle of a group of people or things; in the middle of, in the midst of
words.translation: 在…之中；在…中间

examples.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
examples.zh: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

examples.en: I could hear voices coming from somewhere among the bushes.
examples.zh: 我能听到灌木丛中某个地方传来说话的声音。

examples.en: We walked among the chestnut woods on the mountain slopes.
examples.zh: 我们走在山坡上的栗树林中。

words.definition: a quantity of something such as time, money, or a substance; foot, gross total; sum, quantity of, gross, total
words.translation: 总数；数量；和；[会计]总计，合计；相当于；[数]共计；产生…结果；总额，[数]总数

examples.en: Please pay the full amount (=  of money  ) by the end of the month.
examples.zh: 请在月底前全额付清。

words.definition: used to join two words, phrases etc referring to things that are related in some way; granted, et, but, yet, only
words.translation: 和，又，并，则；和，与；就；而且；但是；然后

examples.en: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
examples.zh: 他去买炸鱼薯条了。

examples.en: The film starred Jack Lemmon and Shirley Maclaine.
examples.zh: 这部电影由杰克·莱蒙和雪莉·麦克莱恩主演。

examples.en: We’ve dealt with items one, two, and eleven.
examples.zh: 我们已经处理了第一项、第二项和第十一项。

words.definition: feeling strong emotions which make you want to shout at someone or hurt them because they have behaved in an unfair, cruel, offensive etc way, or because you think that a situation is unfair, unacceptable etc; riley, vexed
words.translation: 愤怒的，生气的；生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的

examples.en: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
examples.zh: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

examples.en: He was beginning to get angry .
examples.zh: 他开始发脾气了。

examples.en: His comments brought an angry response from opposition politicians.
examples.zh: 他的话激起反对派政客愤怒的回应。

words.definition: different, diverse, other, unlike, varying
words.translation: 再一个的；别的；又一，另一；另外的；不同的

examples.en: Can you cite another case like this one?
examples.zh: 你能举出另一个像这样的例子吗?

words.definition: having, possessory; somewhat, in some sort
words.translation: 什么，一些；任何的；所有的；丝毫；稍微；少许

examples.en: We could not reason out which way the robbers escaped, because we were unable to find any trace of them.
examples.zh: 我们推断不出这些强盗是从哪个方向逃走的，因为我们找不到他们的任何踪迹。

words.definition: used to refer to any person, when it is not important to say exactly who
words.translation: 任何人

examples.en: Anyone could win tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚任何人都可能赢。

examples.en: They offer help and advice to anyone interested in becoming a teacher.
examples.zh: 他们为任何有兴趣当老师的人提供帮助和咨询。

examples.en: If anyone sees Lisa, ask her to call me.
examples.zh: 如果有谁看见莉萨，叫她打电话给我。

words.definition: any thing, event, situation etc, when it is not important to say exactly which
words.translation: 任何事物；一切

examples.en: You can buy anything you want.
examples.zh: 你想要什么都可以买。

examples.en: He was prepared to do anything to make a bit of money.
examples.zh: 只要能赚一点钱，他什么都愿意做。

examples.en: Anything would be better than staying at home!
examples.zh: 做什么都比待在家里好！

words.definition: a particular part of a country, town etc; district, region, extent, boundary, spectrum, territory
words.translation: 面积；地区；领域；区域，[地理]地区；范围

examples.en: Only cheeses made in this area may be labelled ‘Roquefort.’
examples.zh: 只有这个地区出产的干酪才能被称作“罗克福尔干酪”。

examples.en: Crime rates are much higher in urban areas.
examples.zh: 城镇地区的犯罪率要高很多。

words.definition: approximately, everywhere, throughout, something; round
words.translation: 在…周围；大约；到处；在附近；四处

examples.en: What an inspiration she was to all around her!
examples.zh: 她对于她周围所有的人是一种多么大的鼓舞!

examples.en: All those around him looked at him with amazement.
examples.zh: 周围的人都对他投射出惊异的眼光。

words.definition: the use of painting, drawing,  sculpture  etc to represent things or express ideas; beaux-arts, artwork; artistic; are, am
words.translation: 艺术，美术；技术；艺术；美术；艺术品；艺术的；艺术品的；是（be的变体）

examples.en: the Museum of Modern Art in New York
examples.zh: 纽约现代艺术博物馆

examples.en: an example of early Indian art
examples.zh: 印度早期艺术的范例

words.definition: while or when; because, although, since, for, seeing; in the light of, like; equally, similarly, same, likewise
words.translation: 当…的时候；因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时；如同；当作；以…的身份；同样地；和…一样的

examples.en: I saw Peter as I was getting off the bus.
examples.zh: 我下公共汽车的时候看见了彼得。

examples.en: As time passed, things seemed to get worse.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，情况似乎变得更加糟糕了。

examples.en: Just as the two men were leaving, a message arrived.
examples.zh: 那两个男子刚要离开，消息就传来了。

words.definition: to speak or write to someone in order to get an answer, information, or a solution; invite, lack, question, desire, exact; question, query
words.translation: 问；要求；邀请；问，询问；需要；讨价

examples.en: ‘What’s your name?’ she asked.
examples.zh: “你叫什么名字？”她问道 。

examples.en: Don’t ask him – he won’t know.
examples.zh: 别问他，他不知道。

examples.en: That kid’s always asking awkward questions .
examples.zh: 那孩子总是问一些尴尬的问题。

words.definition: used to say exactly where something or someone is, or where something happens; be, towards, unto, out
words.translation: 在…里；在…时；在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；以（某种价格、速度等）；向；因为；朝；忙于

examples.en: They live at 18 Victoria Street.
examples.zh: 他们住在维多利亚街18 号。

examples.en: Does this train stop at Preston?
examples.zh: 这列火车在普雷斯顿停吗？

examples.en: I was waiting at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我在公共汽车站等着。

words.definition: when you carefully listen to, look at, or think about someone or something; consideration, thought
words.translation: 注意，留心；注意力；关心；立正！（口令）

examples.en: My attention wasn’t really on the game.
examples.zh: 我的注意力其实不在比赛上。

examples.en: She tried to pay attention to what he was saying.
examples.zh: 她尽量注意听他说话。

examples.en: If you paid more attention in class, you might actually learn something!
examples.zh: 要是你上课更认真些，也许能实实在在地学到些东西！

words.definition: a group of people who come to watch and listen to someone speaking or performing in public; reader, interview
words.translation: 听众，观众，读者；观众；听众；读者；接见

examples.en: The audience began clapping and cheering.
examples.zh: 观众开始鼓掌欢呼。

examples.en: One member of the audience described the opera as ‘boring’.
examples.zh: 有一名观众说这出歌剧“乏味”。

words.definition: someone who has written a book; writer, pen

words.translation: 电子的

examples.en: electronic games
examples.zh: 电子游戏

examples.en: an electronic organizer (= a small piece of electronic equipment that you can use to record addresses, phone numbers etc )
examples.zh: 电子记事本

words.definition: besides or in addition to someone or something; You use else after words such as "anywhere," "someone," and "what" to refer in a vague way to another person, place, or thing; otherwise, extra; other, tother
words.translation: 其它，另外；别的；其他；否则；另外；其他的

examples.en: There’s something else I’d like to talk about as well.
examples.zh: 我还有其他事情要谈一谈。

examples.en: I’d like you to come, and anyone else who’s free.
examples.zh: 我想请你过来，其他人有空也可以来。

examples.en: He was awake now, as was everyone else.
examples.zh: 他现在已经醒了，其他人也都醒了。

words.definition: the part of a place or object that is furthest from its beginning or centre; to finish what you are doing; completion, death, target, goal, object; drop, determine, pass; conclude, bring to a close
words.translation: 末端；目标；结束；尽头；死亡；结束，终止；终结

examples.en: He wore spectacles perched on the very end of his nose.
examples.zh: 他的眼镜架在鼻尖上。

examples.en: The end of the pencil snapped.
examples.zh: 铅笔的笔尖啪的一声断了。

examples.en: Jo joined the end of the line.
examples.zh: 乔排到了队尾。

words.definition: power that is used to provide heat, operate machines etc; vitality, spirit, soul, mind, spring
words.translation: 活力；精力；能；[物]能量；[劳经]活力；精神

examples.en: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
examples.zh: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

examples.en: The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.
examples.zh: 核能的问题就是要处理核废料。

words.definition: the language used in Britain, the US, Australia, and some other countries; relating to England or its people; Royal, British; Anglo, British person
words.translation: 英语；英国人的；英文的；英国的；英文；英国人；英格兰人

examples.en: Do you speak English?
examples.zh: 你会说英语吗？

examples.en: leaflets written in plain English
examples.zh: 用简单英语写的传单

words.definition: to get pleasure from something; to appreciate, feast
words.translation: 享受；欣赏，喜爱；欣赏，享受；喜爱；使过得快活

examples.en: Sandra enjoys her job in the city.
examples.zh: 桑德拉很喜欢她在城里的这份工作。

examples.en: I enjoyed every minute of it.
examples.zh: 我每一分钟都很享受。

words.definition: Enough is also an adjective; to the degree that is necessary or wanted; adequately, sufficiently; amplitude, ton, plenty of; adequate, plenitudinous
words.translation: 足够的；足够地；足够地，充足地；很多；充足；充足的

examples.en: Her disappearance and death would give proof enough of Charles' guilt.
examples.zh: 她的失踪和死亡将提供足够的证据证明查尔斯有罪。

words.definition: the air, water, and land on Earth, which is affected by man’s activities; context, circumstance, setting, surrounding, condition
words.translation: 环境，外界；围绕；[环境]环境，外界

examples.en: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
examples.zh: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

examples.en: legislation to protect the environment
examples.zh: 保护环境的法规

examples.en: the effects of acid rain on the environment
examples.zh: 酸雨对环境的影响

words.definition: used to emphasize something that is unexpected or surprising in what you are saying; flat, equivalent, equal, level; actually, really, too, effectively, yet; equate with; flatten out
words.translation: 甚至；甚至更，还；[数]偶数的；平坦的；相等的；即使；还；实际上；使平坦；使相等；变平；变得可比较；成为相等

examples.en: Most companies have suffered a drop in their profits, even very large companies.
examples.zh: 大多数公司的利润都出现下滑，甚至连很大的公司也不例外。

examples.en: It was quite difficult to see, even with the light on.
examples.zh: 这很难看得见，即使开着灯也没有用。

examples.en: He became quite successful and even appeared on a television show once.
examples.zh: 他相当成功，甚至还上了一次电视节目。

words.definition: the early part of the night between the end of the day and the time you go to bed; night, eve, sunset; bonsoir
words.translation: 傍晚，黄昏，晚上；晚上；傍晚；（联欢性的）晚会；后期；晚上好（等于good evening）

examples.en: I do most of my studying in the evening.
examples.zh: 我学习大都在晚上。

examples.en: I’m usually out on Friday evenings.
examples.zh: 周五晚上我通常都不在家。

examples.en: What are you doing tomorrow evening?
examples.zh: 明天晚上你打算做什么？

words.definition: a word meaning at any time; used mostly in questions, negatives, comparisons, or sentences with ‘if’; forever, always, once
words.translation: 在任何时候；曾经；永远；究竟

examples.en: Nothing ever seems to upset him.
examples.zh: 似乎从来没有什么事情会使他烦恼。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?
examples.zh: 你去过巴黎吗？

examples.en: I don’t think I’ve ever been here before.
examples.zh: 我觉得我以前从未到过这里。

words.definition: Every is also an adjective
words.translation: 每一的；每隔…的

examples.en: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
examples.zh: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

words.definition: every person; each one, everybody (a term of address), Every Body
words.translation: 每人，人人；每个人

examples.en: If everyone is ready, I’ll begin.
examples.zh: 如果大家都准备好了，我就开始。

examples.en: Send my best wishes to everyone in the family.
examples.zh: 请向全家人致以最美好的祝愿。

examples.en: Of course everyone else thought it was hilarious!
examples.zh: 当然其他所有人都觉得好笑极了！

words.definition: each thing or all things
words.translation: 每件事，事事

examples.en: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
examples.zh: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

examples.en: I decided to tell her everything.
examples.zh: 我决定把一切都告诉她。

examples.en: Apart from the bus arriving late, everything else seemed to be going according to plan.
examples.zh: 除了公共汽车晚点之外，其他一切似乎都在按计划进行。

words.definition: used when emphasizing that something is no more and no less than a number or amount, or is completely correct in every detail; accurately, correctly, properly, precisely, right
words.translation: 确切地；恰恰正是；恰好地；正是；精确地；正确地

examples.en: It’s exactly half past five.
examples.zh: 一分不差，正好5点半。

examples.en: The figures may not be exactly right, but they’re close enough.
examples.zh: 那些数字可能不是非常精确，但也相当接近。

words.definition: to think that something will happen because it seems likely or has been planned; promise oneself, guess, find, feel, make; look foward to, to look forward to
words.translation: 预料，预期；等待；期望；指望；认为；预料；期待；预期

examples.en: He will be hard to beat. I fully expect (= am completely sure about ) that and I’m ready.
examples.zh: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

examples.en: ‘Who are you?’ he murmured, only half expecting (= thinking it was possible, but not likely ) her to answer.
examples.zh: “你是谁？”他低声问道，预计她可能不会回答。

examples.en: He didn’t get his expected pay rise.
examples.zh: 他没有得到他预想的加薪。

words.definition: costing a lot of money; rich, dear, costly
words.translation: 昂贵的，花钱多的；昂贵的；花钱的

examples.en: the most expensive restaurant in town
examples.zh: 城里最贵的餐馆

examples.en: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.
examples.zh: 汽油越来越贵了。

examples.en: Photography is an expensive hobby.
examples.zh: 摄影是一项很花钱的业余爱好。

words.definition: knowledge or skill that you gain from doing a job or activity, or the process of doing this; areer; suffer, live, undergo
words.translation: 经验，感受；经历；经验；体验

examples.en: The advice in the booklet reflects the practical experience we have gained (= experience gained by actually doing something, rather than knowledge from books etc ).
examples.zh: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

examples.en: I had some experience in fashion design.
examples.zh: 我有一些时装设计方面的经验。

examples.en: She was turned down on the grounds of lack of experience.
examples.zh: 她因缺乏经验而被拒绝。

words.definition: to tell someone about something in a way that is clear or easy to understand; bring sb to do sth, go to show
words.translation: 解释；为…辩解；说明

examples.en: He carefully explained the procedure.
examples.zh: 他仔细解释了程序。

words.definition: to tell or show what you are feeling or thinking by using words, looks, or actions; a train or bus that does not stop in many places and therefore travels quickly; voice, put; precise, decided, technical, rapid, specific; rapido, flier
words.translation: 表示；快车，快递；表达；快递；明确的；迅速的；专门的；[交]快车，快递，专使；捷运公司

examples.en: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
examples.zh: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

examples.en: She expressed an interest in seeing York.
examples.zh: 她表示有兴趣见见约克。

examples.en: Many people have expressed their opposition to the proposals.
examples.zh: 许多人反对这些提议。

words.definition: to a very great degree; badly, highly, greatly, too, rare
words.translation: 极端，极其，非常；非常，极其；极端地

examples.en: Earthquakes are extremely difficult to predict.
examples.zh: 地震非常难以预测。

examples.en: I’m extremely sorry to have troubled you.
examples.zh: 给你添了麻烦，我十分抱歉。

words.definition: one of the two parts of the body that you use to see with; viewpoint, vision, sight, perspective, outlook; watch, look, behold
words.translation: 眼睛；眼力；鉴赏力；[解剖]眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点；注视，看

examples.en: He’s got beautiful eyes.
examples.zh: 他有一双漂亮的眼睛。

examples.en: There were tears in her eyes as she listened to the story.
examples.zh: 她听故事时眼里噙着泪水。

examples.en: Ow! I’ve got something in my eye!
examples.zh: 哎呀！我眼睛里进了什么东西！

words.definition: the front part of your head, where your eyes, nose, and mouth are; surface, outside, garment, look; open to; accept, agree, recognize, look, grant
words.translation: 脸；表面；外表；面子；面容；外观；威信；向；朝；面对；面向；承认；抹盖

examples.en: She had a beautiful face.
examples.zh: 她面容秀美。

examples.en: Her face was white with fear.
examples.zh: 她吓得脸煞白。

examples.en: A big smile spread across his face.
examples.zh: 他的脸上绽开了灿烂笑容。

words.definition: a piece of information that is known to be true; truth, reality, actuality
words.translation: 事实；实际，实情；实际；真相

examples.en: Our decision to build the museum in Hartlepool was influenced by the fact that there were no national museums in the North East.
examples.zh: 我们之所以决定在哈特尔浦建造博物馆，是因为东北地区没有国家级的博物馆。

words.definition: to move or drop down from a higher position to a lower position; become, come, lower; reduction, decline, autumn; floor, cut sth down; autumn
words.translation: 落下；跌倒；陷落；变成；来临；减弱；[气象]下降；秋天；瀑布；砍倒；击倒；秋天的

examples.en: The tree was about to fall.
examples.zh: 那棵树快要倒下了。

examples.en: The book fell from his hands.
examples.zh: 书从他手上跌落。

examples.en: Enough rain had fallen to flood the grounds.
examples.zh: 雨量很大，淹没了地面。

words.definition: a group of people who are related to each other, especially a mother, a father, and their children; household, folk, race; household, domestic, home
words.translation: 家，家庭；家族；家庭；家属；子女；亲属；僚属；家庭的，家族的

examples.en: Do you know the family next door?
examples.zh: 你认识隔壁那家人吗？

examples.en: The Webb family still has its farm over there.
examples.zh: 韦伯家依然保留着那里的农场。

examples.en: The family now live in London.
examples.zh: 那家人现居伦敦。

words.definition: known about by many people in many places; noted, wonderful, excellent, super, great
words.translation: 著名的，出名的；著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的

examples.en: a famous actor
examples.zh: 著名演员

examples.en: Many famous people have stayed in the hotel.
examples.zh: 许多名人都曾下榻这家酒店。

examples.en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark (= a famous place or building that is easy to recognize ) .
examples.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是著名的地标。

words.definition: a long distance away; used to talk about how much progress someone makes, or how much effect something has; greatly, quite, badly, too, powerful; hoary, agelong; distance, distant place
words.translation: 远的；远，遥远；很；遥远地；久远地；到很远的距离；到很深的程度；久远的；远方

examples.en: We can walk to my house from here. It isn’t far.
examples.zh: 我们可以从这里步行去我家，不远。

examples.en: You could see the mountains in the far distance.
examples.zh: 你可以看到远处的群山。

words.definition: moving or able to move quickly; moving quickly; rapid, sudden, tight, forward, ready; quickly, rapidly, thoroughly, entirely, completely, fully; apastia, starvation
words.translation: 快的；偏快的；快；[摄]快速的，迅速的；紧的，稳固的；迅速地；紧紧地；彻底地；斋戒；绝食

examples.en: a fast car
examples.zh: 速度很快的汽车

examples.en: He’s one of the fastest runners in the world.
examples.zh: 他是世界上跑得最快的人之一。

words.definition: a male parent; dad, root, da, daddy, priest; found, construct, institute
words.translation: 父亲；神父；创始人；父亲，爸爸；祖先；前辈；发明，创立；当…的父亲

examples.en: Ask your father to help you.
examples.zh: 叫你父亲帮你。

examples.en: Andrew was very excited about becoming a father.
examples.zh: 安德鲁初为人父，非常激动。

examples.en: He’s been like a father to me.
examples.zh: 对我来说，他就像父亲一样。

words.definition: If you feel a particular emotion or physical sensation, you experience it; to give you a particular physical feeling, especially when you touch or hold something; expect, count, guess, find, make; fish for, poke about; consciousness, sense perception
words.translation: 有知觉；触，摸；感觉；认为；触摸；试探；觉得；摸索

examples.en: I am feeling very depressed.
examples.zh: 我感到很沮丧。

examples.en: Suddenly I felt a sharp pain in my shoulder.
examples.zh: 我突然感到肩部一阵剧痛。

examples.en: I felt as if all my strength had gone.
examples.zh: 我觉得好象自己的力气已经全没了。

words.translation: 感情；感觉，知觉；[生理]感觉，触觉；[心理]感情，情绪；同情；有感觉的；有同情心的；富于感情的；[生理]感觉；认为（feel的现在分词）；触摸

examples.en: Knowing we’d won was a wonderful feeling.
examples.zh: 得知我们赢了，感觉真好。

words.definition: Few is also an adjective; tiny, little, small
words.translation: 很少的；少数的；几乎没有的

examples.en: ...spending her few waking hours in front of the TV.
examples.zh: …把她清醒的个把钟头花在电视机前。

words.definition: a story that is told using sound and moving pictures, shown at a cinema or on television; movie, membrane, cinema; cinematograph
words.translation: 影片；胶卷；薄层；[电影]电影；薄膜；[感光]胶卷；轻烟；在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影

examples.en: Have you seen any good films recently?
examples.zh: 你最近看过什么好的影片吗？

words.definition: after a long time; eventually, ultimately, lastly
words.translation: 最后；不可更改的；终于；决定性地

examples.en: After several delays we finally took off at six o’clock.
examples.zh: 几经耽搁后，我们终于在六点起飞了。

examples.en: Finally, Karpov cracked under the pressure.
examples.zh: 最后，卡尔波夫承受不住压力崩溃了。

words.definition: to discover, see, or get something that you have been searching for; detect, earn, acquire, expect, count; discovery, occurrence, detection, anagnorisis
words.translation: 找到；发觉；找出；发现；认为；感到；获得

examples.en: I can’t find the car keys.
examples.zh: 我找不到汽车钥匙。

examples.en: Hold on while I find a pen.
examples.zh: 别挂电话，我找支笔。

examples.en: Her body was later found hidden in the bushes.
examples.zh: 后来有人发现她的尸体被藏在了灌木丛里。

words.definition: the information that someone has discovered as a result of their study, work etc; discovery, occurrence, detection
words.translation: 发现；调查的结果；裁决；发现物

examples.en: Surveys conducted in other countries reported similar findings.
examples.zh: 在其他国家进行的调查也报告说有类似的结果。

words.definition: uncontrolled flames, light, and heat that destroy and damage things; to shoot bullets or bombs; passion, flame, warmth; remove, light, loose; warm, pop
words.translation: 火；火灾；开火；[安全]火灾；炮火；炉火；热情；激情；磨难；点燃；解雇；开除；使发光；烧制；激动；放枪；着火；[军]射击；开枪；烧火

examples.en: The warehouse was completely destroyed by fire.
examples.zh: 仓库全给烧毁了。

examples.en: Thirty people died in a fire in downtown Chicago.
examples.zh: 30人死于芝加哥市中心的一场火灾。

examples.en: Police think that the fire was started deliberately.
examples.zh: 警方认为有人故意纵火。

words.definition: a business or company, especially a small one; committed, strict, precise, rigid, confirmed; steady; steadily; corporation, establishment, company, incorporation
words.translation: 商行，商号，公司；坚定的；牢固的；严格的；结实的；使坚定；使牢固；稳固地；公司；商号

examples.en: The firm's employees were expecting large bonuses.
examples.zh: 这家公司的雇员们正期待着大笔的奖金。

words.definition: something that has never happened or been done before; before anything or anyone else; primarily, soon, initially, rather; threshold, conception, beginning, opening, title; elementary, premier, fundamental, basic, essential
words.translation: 第一；最初；首先；优先；宁愿；开始；冠军；第一的；基本的；最早的

examples.en: These results are firsts in the history of women’s athletics.
examples.zh: 这些成绩在女运动员历史上是第一次。

examples.en: ‘I think he’ll agree to it.’ ‘ That will be a first .’
examples.zh: “我想他会同意的。”“那倒是破天荒头一遭。”

words.definition: the number 5; cinque, pentad
words.translation: 五，五个，第五；五，五个；五美元钞票

examples.en: There is also a golf course five miles away.
examples.zh: 五英里外还有个高尔夫球场。

examples.en: I’ll be back by five (= five o’clock ) .
examples.zh: 我五点前回来。

examples.en: The family moved to Canada when he was five (= five years old ) .
examples.zh: 他五岁时全家移居加拿大。

words.definition: if your eyes focus, or if you focus your eyes, you look at something and can see it clearly; the thing, person, situation etc that people pay special attention to; center, hub, fairness; centralize; concentrate, band
words.translation: 聚焦，注视；焦点；[光][数]焦点；中心；清晰；焦距；使集中；[光][摄]使聚焦；集中；[光][摄]聚焦；调节焦距

examples.en: His eyes were focussed straight ahead.
examples.zh: 他的双眼盯着正前方。

words.definition: to go, walk, drive etc behind or after someone else; string along, ambition; string along, go on to; me-tooism, sycophancy
words.translation: 跟随；结果是；遵循；追求；密切注意；接着；追随

examples.en: Are those men following us?
examples.zh: 那些人在跟着我们吗？

examples.en: The patrol car followed the BMW for a few miles and then lost it.
examples.zh: 巡逻车跟了那辆宝马几英里，后来就跟丢了。

examples.en: Tom’s already gone out to Rome and his wife and children will follow shortly.
examples.zh: 汤姆已经去罗马了，他的妻儿很快就会跟着去。

words.definition: You use following to refer to something that you are about to mention; under, coming, next
words.translation: 接着的；下列的；下面的；其次的，接着的

examples.en: Write down the following information: name of product, type, date purchased and price.
examples.zh: 写下以下信息：产品名称、型号、购买日期和价格。

words.definition: things that people and animals eat, such as vege-tables or meat; diet, eating, nourishment
words.translation: 食物，食品，养料；[食品]食物；养料

examples.en: The restaurant serves good food at affordable prices.
examples.zh: 那家餐厅物美价廉。

examples.en: I love Italian food, especially pasta.
examples.zh: 我喜欢意大利食物，尤其是面食。

examples.en: He was told to cut down on salty and fatty foods.

words.translation: 追求；继续；从事；追赶；纠缠；继续进行

examples.en: She plans to pursue a career in politics.
examples.zh: 她计划从政。

examples.en: Students should pursue their own interests , as well as do their school work.
examples.zh: 除了完成课业之外，学生也应该追求自己的兴趣。

examples.zh: 贯彻扶贫政策的竞选承诺

words.definition: yield, desert, split, get out; split, get out; leaving, Gone away
words.translation: 放弃；离开；停止；使…解除；[劳经]辞职；[计]退出

examples.en: There are no failures in life, only those who quit before success.
examples.zh: 生活中没有失败者，只有那些在成功前就放弃的人。

examples.en: With this view there are no failures only those who quit before success.
examples.zh: 这样看就没有失败的人，只有那些在胜利之前就放弃的人。

words.definition: a difficult time when there is less trade, business activity etc in a country than usual; depression, downturn, decline, cavity
words.translation: 衰退；不景气；后退；凹处

examples.en: the economic recession of the early 1980s
examples.zh: 20世纪80年代初的经济衰退

examples.en: There is deep recession in the UK.
examples.zh: 英国处于严重的经济衰退之中。

words.definition: to start doing something instead of another person, or start being used instead of another thing; restore, return, shift, tender
words.translation: 代替；取代，代替；替换，更换；归还，偿还；把…放回原处

examples.en: I’m replacing Sue on the team.
examples.zh: 我将接替队里的休。

examples.en: Lectures have replaced the old tutorial system.
examples.zh: 课堂授课取代了旧式的导师制。

words.definition: the opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past; credit, name, fame, celebrity, prestige
words.translation: 名气，名声，名誉；名声，名誉；声望

examples.en: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
examples.zh: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

words.definition: a specific thing, person, or group is one particular thing, person, or group; precise, strict, decided, detailed, particular; quality, tang, identity, detail, character
words.translation: 特定的，具体的；特殊的，特定的；明确的；详细的；[药]具有特效的；特性；细节；特效药

examples.en: games suitable for specific age groups
examples.zh: 适合特定年龄组的游戏

examples.en: a specific example of alcohol’s effect on the body
examples.zh: 酒精对身体影响的具体例子

words.definition: to scatter seeds,  manure  etc on the ground; extend, push; distribute, string, transmit; circulation, extension, propagation, diffusion; extense, patulous

examples.en: The industrial revolution, which started a couple of hundred years ago in Europe, is now spreading across the world.
examples.zh: 几百年前始于欧洲的工业革命现在正向全世界扩散。

words.definition: to think that something is probably true, especially something bad; someone who is thought to be guilty of a crime; sus; doubtful, questionable; dispute, imagine, wonder, question; wonder, imagine, question, suppose
words.translation: 怀疑，猜想；嫌疑犯；[法]嫌疑犯；可疑的；不可信的；怀疑；猜想

examples.en: She strongly suspected he was lying to her.
examples.zh: 她非常怀疑他在对她撒谎。

examples.en: She’s not going to be very happy about this, I suspect .
examples.zh: 我想对于此事她不会太高兴。

words.definition: to talk in a friendly informal way, especially about things that are not important; visit with, chew the fat; chinwag, chit-chat
words.translation: 聊天；闲谈

examples.en: John and I sat up until the early hours chatting.
examples.zh: 我和约翰聊到凌晨才睡。

words.definition: Hit is also a noun; dong, impact on; impact on, beat upon; success, prosperity, victory, blow, stroke
words.translation: 成功, 打击；打击；袭击；碰撞；偶然发现；伤…的感情；打；偶然碰上；（演出等）成功；讽刺

examples.en: First a house took a direct hit and then the rocket exploded.
examples.zh: 首先一幢房子被直接击中，接着火箭弹爆炸了。

words.definition: things that are done to keep a person, building, or country safe from danger or crime; safety, assurance, certification, commitment, guarantee; safe, restricted
words.translation: 安全，安保；[安全]安全；保证；证券；抵押品；[安全]安全的；保安的；保密的

examples.en: The trial was held under tight security .
examples.zh: 这场审讯是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。

examples.en: lax security at airline check-in desks
examples.zh: 登机手续柜台松懈的安全措施

examples.en: terrorist activity that is a threat to national security
examples.zh: 威胁国家安全的恐怖活动

words.definition: something important that you succeed in doing by your own efforts; effort, completion, success, execution, accomplishment
words.translation: 完成；成就，成绩；成就；达到

examples.en: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
examples.zh: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

words.definition: to disagree with someone in words, often in an angry way; debate, dispute about; debate, discuss, demonstrate, prove, satisfy
words.translation: 争论，争辩，辩论；争论，辩论；提出理由；辩论，争论；证明；说服

examples.en: We could hear the neighbours arguing.
examples.zh: 我们听到邻居在争吵。

words.definition: to go to an event such as a meeting or a class; present oneself, invite, serve, board, mind; present oneself, nurse
words.translation: 出席；照顾，护理；上（大学等）；照料；招待；陪伴；致力于；照顾

examples.en: Only 12 people attended the meeting.
examples.zh: 只有12个人出席了会议。

examples.en: Please let us know if you are unable to attend.
examples.zh: 如果不能出席，请通知我们。

words.definition: to make someone interested in something, or make them want to take part in something; engage, absorb, produce, cause, operate; appeal, turn one on
words.translation: 吸引；引起，诱惑；引起；有吸引力

examples.en: I’m not usually attracted to blondes.
examples.zh: 我一般不喜欢金发女子。
